purpose: The GET route+query variant used only to force the mock into rendering exactly one workflow's DOM section, for the INC-09A workflow-detection proof.
notes: The ?workflow= query parameter is INC-09A mock-only test infrastructure (mock_server.py's _render_mission_page docstring), invented for this increment's own offline testing -- it is definitionally not a confirmed live contract of any kind. Distinct RouteContract from mission_index_navigation_mock_only.json because evaluate_request compares query_fields by exact set equality: a bare '/index' request and an '/index?workflow=...' request canonicalize to different query_fields and therefore need two separate reviewed contracts.
